content.title: Pure Storage Stock Slides 27% on Earnings. What Is Weighing on the Shares.
content.summary: The data storage company posted adjusted earnings of 58 cents a share for the quarter, in line with analysts’ estimates.  Pure Storage announced plans to reinvest part of its revenue from sales to artificial-intelligence hyperscalers into research and development as well as sales and marketing.  Also, while the company’s revenue beat was nice, it was narrower than its outperformance in the second quarter, analysts at Guggenheim Securities noted.

content.title: Pure Storage Stock Slides Despite Strong Quarterly Report. Here's What Wall Street Is Saying.
content.summary: Pure Storage stock sank more than 20% on Wednesday, despite quarterly results that either met or exceeded analyst expectations.  Pure Storage stock had rallied more than 50% year-to-date heading into the report.  Pure Storage on Tuesday reported adjusted earnings of 58 cents per share on sales of $964.5 million for its fiscal third quarter, which ended Nov. 2.
